name: Caitlin Halderman
bio: Caitlin Halderman Chaniago (born 17 July 2000) is an Indonesian actress, singer and presenter. She made her acting debut as the female lead character in 2016 film, Ada Cinta Di SMA. Her name became widely known after playing, Love Letter for Starla in 2017. She is of Dutch descent.

credits.title: Ivanna 2
credits.overview: Five years after surviving a massacre at a nursing home, Ambar, Dika, and Rina face Ivanna’s terror once again in a hospital. When a nurse is found beheaded, they realize Ivanna has returned and must be stopped before more victims fall.

credits.title: Baby Udon
credits.overview: A young Indonesian woman and a Japanese man build a life together after falling in love and marrying, but their dream of having a child is tested by repeated heartbreak and his eventual cancer diagnosis.

credits.title: Promised Hearts
credits.overview: A young woman's future is jeopardized by a secret arrangement that throws her life into chaos — but it may be the only way to save her family.

credits.title: A Business Proposal
credits.overview: Short on cash, food analyst Sari makes a deal to go on a blind date, only to realize she's been set up with Utama, her hateable but handsome boss.

credits.title: My Annoying Brother
credits.overview: When a gifted athlete loses his sight, his convict brother sees an excuse for early parole. But with their joyful reunion comes tragedy.

credits.title: Menjelang Ajal
credits.overview: When a struggling mother becomes possessed by an evil spirit meant to help her business, her three children desperately seek help to cure her.

credits.title: Melodate
credits.overview: Melody and her friends rebelled against the rules of the girls' dormitory where they lived until she met Dante, the son of the owner of their girls' dormitory. All the rebellion plans led by Melody went awry, her friendship with her dorm friends became increasingly strained.

credits.title: Ancika
credits.overview: When the former leader of a motorcycle crew tries to win the heart of an unconventional student, his romantic pursuit quickly turns into a bumpy ride.

credits.title: Dunia Tanpa Suara
credits.overview: The opening day of Tea Shop "Yang Bercerita" will be the day that will change the story of Arissa's friendship with Kania and Arissa-Ezra's imperfect love.

credits.title: Until Tomorrow
credits.overview: Haka and Sarah have to face trials before their wedding, because Sarah was diagnosed with stage three cancer.

credits.title: Ivanna
credits.overview: Ambar & Dika have just begun with a new chapter of life when years-old grudge of a malicious entity unfolds before their eyes. With a gift she unwillingly has, Ambar is now forced to finish the vengeance of the entity, a headless Dutch spirit, Ivanna.

credits.title: The Watcher
credits.overview: Krishna who had to languish at home because of an injury. In order not to get bored, he uses the binoculars his friends gave him to look at his beautiful neighbor named Tiara.  One day, Krishna accidentally found out that a group of people were planning to kidnap Tiara. He tried to stop the plan before it was too late.

credits.title: Dignitate
credits.overview: Alfi meets Alana, a new student at school. It turns out that they are in one class and sitting next to each other. Instead of getting along, they often argue because they both are stubborn.

credits.title: DreadOut
credits.overview: A group of high school friends decide to livestream themselves inside a haunted apartment building, but end up opening a portal to Hell.

credits.title: Forever Holiday in Bali
credits.overview: A K-Pop artist meets a local girl in Bali. Problems arise when they started to be in love with one another.

credits.title: Love Letter for Starla
credits.overview: After a street artist and a coffee shop manager fall in love in just six hours, stunning revelations threaten to cause an even faster fallout.

credits.title: The Guys
credits.overview: Hapless office worker Alfi needs help from his pals when he unexpectedly falls for the daughter of his boss — a stern man with eyes for Alfi's mom.

credits.title: Hangout
credits.overview: After nine celebrities accept an invitation to visit a remote island, they find themselves trapped with a mysterious killer hunting them down.

credits.title: There Is Love in High School
credits.overview: In this high school musical, a talented teen tries to change his reputation by running for student council president against his ambitious friend.
